name: V-Monsters Forgotten Link
detailed_description:
You grew up capturing and evolving monsters... but now it's time for something new.

V-Monsters Forgotten Link is a monster taming RPG with turn-based battles, a branching narrative, and a war-torn world waiting to be explored. Choose your protagonist — a conscripted soldier from the North or a survivor from the devastated South — and uncover the truth behind the chaos consuming Folklora.

Capture unique creatures, train your V-Monsters, and unlock their full potential. Every choice matters. Your team, your path, your story.

Featuring handcrafted pixel art, an original soundtrack, and deep connections to official comics and light novels, Forgotten Link isn’t just a game — it’s your gateway to an entire universe.

Key Features

  • Two protagonists, two perspectives: each journey shows a different side of the war.

  • Capture, train, evolve: every V-Monster has multiple evolution paths.

  • Emotionally-driven story: pick a side and face the consequences.

  • Pixel art with soul: all monsters, characters, and environments are drawn by hand.

  • Original soundtrack: every area has its own musical identity.

  • Expanded universe: continue the story through official comics and light novels.

Which side of the story will you choose?
